cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.4.2.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/sessions/ecstatic-eloquent-darwin/mnt/csound7_tilde/PD/build/sndfile-static/src/cmake")
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-DCHECK_FUNCTION_EXISTS=floor]==] [==[/D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64]==] [==[/D_LARGE_FILES]==] [==[/D_LARGEFILE_SOURCE]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0210 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0214 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/sessions/ecstatic-eloquent-darwin/mnt/csound7_tilde/PD/build/sndfile-static/build-linux-aarch64/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-om5nzV")
add_executable(cmTC_d7bb7)
target_sources(cmTC_d7bb7 PRIVATE
  "/sessions/ecstatic-eloquent-darwin/mnt/csound7_tilde/PD/build/sndfile-static/build-linux-aarch64/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-om5nzV/CheckFunctionExists.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_d7bb7_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_d7bb7>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_d7bb7 PROPERTY "C_STANDARD" "99")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_d7bb7 PROPERTY "C_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "TRUE")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_d7bb7  "m" )
